fluff.overview: Clan motorized Points mount five warriors on light vehicles for rapid repositioning between garrison posts. Faster than foot Points and less resource-intensive than mechanized formations, motorized elements handle patrol routes, perimeter screening, and quick-response duties across Clan occupation zones. The vehicles provide speed but minimal protection, and warriors must dismount to fight. Clan commanders value motorized Points for their ability to cover ground quickly on worlds where the garrison force cannot afford dedicated armored transports for every infantry element.
